hero_kpi_rationale: Key metric used by management to compare and assess the underlying operational performance of reporting segments, excluding the impacts of volatility from undesignated derivatives for a better representation of actual operational performance

kpis.name: Adjusted EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Sum of earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization, excluding depreciation charges and unrealized gains/losses on undesignated raw material derivatives
kpis.description: Key indicator of operational performance and cash flow generation capacity

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.description: Key metric for assessing aggregated segment sales growth

kpis.name: Metal Margin - Steel Products
kpis.explanation: Difference between the average selling price per ton of steel products and the scrap cost used by steel mills
kpis.description: Critical indicator for tracking profitability of vertically integrated steel products

risks.title: Fluctuations in raw material prices
risks.score_rationale: Scrap and other input prices have historically been subject to significant fluctuations and the company may not always adjust product prices to recover rapid increases in raw material costs, particularly in the short term and under fixed-price contracts. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Limited availability of critical inputs
risks.score_rationale: The company relies on scrap, graphite electrodes and other inputs for its steel mill operations and may be unable to secure adequate supply on acceptable terms. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The company faces competition from larger firms with greater resources, which could impact market share and profitability. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Trade tariff risks
risks.score_rationale: The Executive Order of February 10, 2025 reinstated 25% tariffs on steel imports effective March 12, 2025, increased to 50% on June 4, 2025 for all countries except the UK, extending to manufactured steel products. (Item 7, MDA)

risks.title: Operational disruptions
risks.score_rationale: Operational disruptions, equipment failures or production interruptions may negatively impact production capacity and profitability. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Environmental and compliance risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to increasingly stringent environmental regulations which may impact operational costs and profitability. (Item 1A)

risks.title: Macroeconomic uncertainties
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks related to macroeconomic uncertainty, financial market volatility, changes in economic conditions and rising trade tensions. (Item 7, MDA)
